dialogues.speaker: Uhane
dialogues.text: I'm very sorry, dear guest. Right now, Tete Isle is still under construction — it's not open to the public.

dialogues.speaker: Uhane
dialogues.text: I recommend you and your friends visit Colorfall Cliffs, Guiztli Ridge, and Wavey Bay to enjoy everything the resort has to offer.

dialogues.speaker: Uhane
dialogues.text: But worry not, our staff will notify you as soon as Tete Isle is ready to open. In the meantime, please do enjoy your vacation.
